purpose: Expose context loss or mission drift without disclosing personal identity.
required_first_nonempty_lines: REPOS: <canonical owner/repository names with active branch when known, separated by semicolons; or none>
required_prompt_instruction: Begin every assistant response with two lines before any other content: OBJECTIVE: <the current concrete objective> and REPOS: <canonical owner/repository names with active branch when known, separated by semicolons; or none>.
rules: Keep OBJECTIVE to one concrete sentence.
Use canonical owner/repository names when known.
Include the active branch after a repository when known.
Use REPOS: none only when no repository is relevant.
Update OBJECTIVE when the active mission or phase materially changes.
Do not omit the two lines from progress updates, validation reports, failures, or final responses.
A missing, stale, or materially wrong line is a canary breach and requires reloading the governing conversation state before continuing.

breach_signals.unexpected_none: repository context may have fallen out of memory

proof_ceiling: Static prompt inclusion and response-shape evaluation only; no provider obedience proof without model-run evidence.
